Smoothed Analysis

Their Question: Does this work in general for multicriteria linear programs?

Alex BlackShadows, Mazes, and Breaking Algorithms

Summary

  • Sometimes optimization problems require tradeoffs between multiple objectives
  • We model that as taking a weighted combination of them
  • These problems can be hard in general but were shown to be fixable by perturbation on nice examples and it was asked whether this can be done in general
  • We show the answer is no by reframing it is a geometric problem and constructing a pathological example

Still much remains open: What about perturbing both and ?
